title: 同一入口承载REST、gRPC和长流时，设计按接口验收矩阵。（同入口原生验证）
answer: 两产物分别控制真实同入口代理和按实际协议解释结果。按接口验收鉴权、路由、总/闲置超时、体积与并发；区分REST错误与HTTP200中的RPC错误，并以实际长流停止/限流、GET与POST尝试次数、排空与同客户端重连形成证据。为各接口明确协议、路由匹配、鉴权、总超时/空闲超时、体积及并发上限。分别验证REST错误码、gRPC trailers和状态、流持续与取消，并检查上下游协议。容量测试区分短请求QPS与活跃长流占用，故障恢复需覆盖排空、重试幂等和客户端重连。
review_note: Session09 root native-source candidate; author and independent exact-source matrices/combined gate pending.
body:
操作任务：交付 mixed_config.py 和 mixed_audit.py 两个产物。真实 Envoy1.39.6 同一个回环入口承载 HTTP/1 REST、原生 gRPC C-core HTTP/2 一元与服务端长流。本题不做gRPC-Web/JSON转码，教学鉴权是精确静态测试令牌，不宣称生产身份系统验收。

mixed_config.build(http_port,rpc_port,log_path,node)：返回bootstrap dict，入口与admin使用 __LISTENER__/__ADMIN__ 占位整数端口；node id取node。原生REST后端HTTP1、原生gRPC后端HTTP2，分别用rest/unary/streams cluster；后端C-core transport配置4MiB接收上限（本题不实测4MiB边界）；RPC应用对解码后的StringValue.value UTF-8字节数设置1024上限，实际context.abort返回RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED。这是应用值上限，不是Envoy或C-core帧大小上限。相同入口的旧新代理切换使用自有reuse_port，进程启动drain-time3秒。
路由优先级：GET /rest/retry 实际允许一次5xx重试；/rest/其余方法不重试；/owned.Mixed/Watch 长流；/owned.Mixed/其余一元。每路由覆盖写x-owned-proxy=node供后端对照。REST普通总超时300ms/retry400ms；一元300ms；长流总超时0保留200ms idle；短请求idle可给1s。每路由名依次rest-retry/rest/stream/unary。REST缓冲上限1024，gRPC显式禁用全体buffer过滤器而用真实后端消息大小合同。静态令牌 authorization=Bearer owned-fixture-token 才允许，缺失拒绝。并发上限rest/unary各8，streams=2，有限pending=1，不用全站无限并发换短请求可用。
配置JSON文件访问日志包含 id=%REQ(X-OWNED-ID)%, protocol=%PROTOCOL%,upstream_protocol=%UPSTREAM_PROTOCOL%,route=%ROUTE_NAME%,status=%RESPONSE_CODE%,grpc_header=%RESP(GRPC-STATUS)%,grpc_trailer=%TRAILER(GRPC-STATUS)%,details=%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%,flags=%RESPONSE_FLAGS%,attempts=%UPSTREAM_REQUEST_ATTEMPT_COUNT%。需要保留实际协议与原始错误状态，不把所有失败改HTTP200或RPC OK。

mixed_audit.outcomes(records)：只读输入records，按实际id返回dict，每项恰含 failed(bool),origin(upstream/proxy/client),code(int),downstream_protocol,upstream_protocol(无上游为None)。每记录protocol=http/grpc，actual给真实http_status或grpc_status，log给真实Envoy上述字段。HTTP code>=400失败；gRPC status!=0失败，不能把HTTP200当RPC成功。C-core状态1表示本题客户端取消，origin=client；其余details=via_upstream表示upstream，否则proxy。协议字段据实际日志，不补造未访问的上游协议。不把同一入口等同各协议合同相同。ID是不透明关联键；派生ID/顺序输入明确为离线核对，非原生新事件。

验收方法：单入口实际REST200/503/404/403/413/504；真实RPC业务错误HTTP200+status9、鉴权7、超时14、后端应用值上限实际RPC8及trailers；持续长流、真实空闲超时、两活动流下10次短请求与一元、第三流拒绝且无后端进入，主动取消后实际停止。实际GET上游两次而POST一次；admin graceful drain开始时旧流仍活动，50条流正常结束后显式SIGTERM自有旧PID，然后原同一个C-core客户端在相同入口重连新代理。admin drain不等于进程自动退出，不声称抓取了原始GOAWAY包或生产发布SLA。原始access JSONL、HTTP正文、SDK结果、config_dump/stats/进程日志均保留。原生C-core的工作进程内运行时FD可能存活至进程退出；外层工作进程退出/FD与端口线程边界必须真实关闭。

原始需求保留：
综合设计题：给出方案、失败边界、可观测证据和验收标准。
为各接口明确协议、路由匹配、鉴权、总超时/空闲超时、体积及并发上限。分别验证REST错误码、gRPC trailers和状态、流持续与取消，并检查上下游协议。容量测试区分短请求QPS与活跃长流占用，故障恢复需覆盖排空、重试幂等和客户端重连。
REST/unary的8并发限额由真实admin config_dump核对，实际占用/第3条拒绝压力实验覆盖streams=2；不声称已对REST/unary进行8路占满压力。
rubric: 同入口真实HTTP1与原生gRPC/HTTP2一元和长流，分别校验上下游协议及status/trailers。
实际鉴权、体积、总/闲置超时及并发边界，不以无限缓冲规避。
实际GET重试/POST不重试、长流取消、旧流排空与客户端重连。
按真实code/details给出协议失败/来源，原始证据与资源关闭正确。

topic: 双版本兼容性与成对回退门禁
title: Envoy升级验收：真实双版本过滤器、RDS分组与二进制配置成对回退
review_note: 仅平台可载入作者草稿；题级原生作者、非作者和精确合批状态另见sidecar，工具cap不计完成。
body:
## 操作任务
在gateway.py完成configure(bootstrap)、assess(bundle)以及python3 gateway.py B报告CLI，交付旧新版Envoy HTTP过滤器与配置成对回退的验收门禁。固定官方旧1.38.6和新1.39.6裸ELF，不能只凭进程存活、--mode validate或注册扩展清单说任意API兼容，也不能仅把二进制换回旧版就声称配置已回退。原题范围的方案、失败边界、观测和验收标准，落实为本题有界原生实验和机器可复核报告；不执行生产或镜像变更。

## 产物与configure接口
可信检查器生成含新测试公钥、实际回环端口、RDS源和完整过滤器对象的bootstrap，并以故意不正确的过滤顺序传入configure。返回一个新bootstrap，不修改输入；只可重新排列static_resources.listeners[0].filter_chains[0].filters[0].typed_config.http_filters，保留所有过滤器对象及其余字段（字典键顺序不要求一致，不能删过滤器或改key/地址/限额/日志）。参考依赖是JWT验证后用已验证metadata做RBAC，再做有限local rate limit；gzip可用满足真实行为的等价位置，router必须满足Envoy终结过滤器约束。不要把任意reader请求头当身份。返回资源真实用于两个版本的bootstrap验证和启动，旧二进制替换时也真实重新调用接口；这是实际配置作用，不是只审一段JSON。
configure在自己的UID1000子进程实际调用，返回值及调用后参数分别保全，标准print诊断被转到stderr。学员无需实现JWT签发服务或RDS服务；真实测试JWT由新Go标准库RSA/JWK/RS256程序在本轮重新构建执行，私钥不输出，Envoy用inline JWKS实际验签。不存在生产issuer访问或系统账号切换。

## 真实范围和对照
每轮启动两版官方Envoy及正式generated v3 RouteDiscoveryService.StreamRoutes（SotW），两个自有HTTP后端。两个版本均实际验证缺失/过期/错误签名JWT→401且无后端执行、真实签名但role不符→403、reader成功→200且actual gzip原bytes可解压为正确正文。受控/limited为2个token：两次无JWT先401不能消耗令牌，然后两次reader上游成功、第三次429无后端执行，普通路径仍可成功。原access log、实际上游计数、状态/flags/details、原响应字节分别保留。
额外实际运行三个对照：RBAC置于JWT之前导致合法reader被403；local limiter置于JWT之前，先两次无JWT401却消耗token，随后reader429；实际关闭压缩的合法已ACK配置使reader HTTP200但没有gzip。这些均为真实官方Envoy，不是伪造状态表。对照均不能通过正常策略矩阵，即使bootstrap验证为0。
两版本兼容基线A实际ACK；分别发送缺必需path_specifier的坏资源，各自实际NACK且保留先前A。依据真实Node版本只给新cohort发布B，确认新B/旧A及各自active版本；不能泛化单资源NACK为全局回滚。停止新Envoy并用旧ELF在自有原监听地址重启时，控制服务仍持B，因此实际旧binary仍请求B；再恢复已验证兼容A配置并实际ACK、请求A和策略矩阵均恢复，才是成对回退。
范围只含本题测试的HTTP/1.1、JWT/RBAC/local rate limit/gzip/router及v3 RouteConfiguration；原Node完整registry和真实bootstrap、资源、--version分别保全，但未测试的API组合/HTTP2或生产灰度不获兼容认证。每次Go build及CLI/validate真实命令有monotonic耗时和缓存是否预存，不回填先前工具cap缺失的独立冷build时间，也不把单机耗时当生产性能结论。

## assess输入
B是由本轮真实原生记录选择字段形成的明确投影，不是原始protobuf。provenance含原生完整stdout SHA；原wire在SDK解码前、响应在正式序列化后截获，均另有原bytes/SHA和同stream/type/nonce关联。profiles每项含不透明id、实际binary_version、validate_exit、registered_tested_extensions和requests。requests保留request_id、label、path、token_label（reader、wrong_role、expired、wrong_signature或null）、真实status(int)、content_encoding、upstream_count、actual_backend、decoded_sha256/raw_body_sha256。可信采集器已实际解压所有带gzip响应并交叉核对后端；assess记录这些实际观察，不额外承诺任意外来压缩流的安全性。
cohorts把old/new/rollback映射到profile id；tested_extensions列本实验6个扩展名（5个HTTP filter加gzip compressor）；resource_type为本轮RouteConfiguration type URL。nacks每项含profile_id、实际解码request、previous_version、active_version、offered_version/offered_nonce。stages有new_selected、old_unselected、binary_only、paired，各项含profile_id、binary_version、active_version、active_cluster、probe_backend、before_version；这是实际admin和实际请求分别观察到的事实，不凭binary版本替代路由事实。rollback_goal给出本次明确恢复目标旧1.38.6/owned-a/backend A。

## 报告精确合同
assess不改输入，返回恰有profiles、rollout、scope；profiles按id字典序。每行恰有id、binary_version、bootstrap_validated(validate_exit==0)、registered_tested_extensions(升序)、status_counts（始终含字符串200/401/403/429四键且值int）、gzip_200_count、uncompressed_200_count、missing_jwt_401_count、invalid_jwt_401_count、wrong_role_403_count、reader_403_count、unauth_limited_401_count、reader_limited_200_count、reader_limited_429_count、passes_policy_matrix。
各计数只按实际requests统计：missing为token_label=null且401，invalid为expired/wrong_signature且401，wrong_role为该token且403，reader_403为reader且403，unauth_limited为null且path=/limited且401，reader_limited为reader且/limited且对应200/429；gzip/uncompressed只分实际200的content_encoding是否gzip。计数必须int不能bool。矩阵通过须validate_exit0、给定tested_extensions均见于该profile registry，missing>=3、invalid>=2、wrong_role>=1、reader_403=0、unauth_limited>=2、reader_limited_200=2、reader_limited_429>=1、gzip_200>=4且uncompressed_200=0；布尔字段必须bool。三种真实坏对照仍保持false，不能因配置可解析而放行。
rollout恰含：compatible_profile_both_passed（old/new两cohort矩阵都通过）；native_nack_count（error_detail存在且type_url为resource_type的记录数）；nack_retains_previous（完整两NACK，且各request.version_info=previous_version=active_version、response_nonce=offered_nonce、offered_version不等于active_version）；version_group_update_isolated（新实测1.39.6/owned-b/B/active_version相对before改变，旧实测1.38.6/owned-a/A/active_version不变）；binary_only_rollback_complete（binary_only的binary_version/active_cluster/probe_backend均达到rollback_goal）；paired_rollback_complete（paired达到上述三目标且rollback cohort策略矩阵通过）；certified_all_APIs固定false。scope固定为tested Envoy1.38.6/1.39.6 HTTP filter profiles and v3 RouteConfiguration; no deployment or all-API claim。
CLI stdout输出与assess同语义单个JSON。等价算法、导入别名和合法gzip过滤位置可用，不强制内部字面调用。API另测试明确派生的证据子集（省略实际已收的一条role拒绝或一条NACK，不能从缺证据推断放行）、非RDS type的NACK类型判别视图、rollback cohort省略role观察视图及等价profile id别名/容器顺序；都标derived/not_Envoy_emitted和来源/派生SHA，原始wire不修改，不宣称这些视图是额外真实网络事件。

## 验收方法与清理
python3 checks/check.py。每轮重新构建执行Go fixture，重新运行两版及三个真实对照、cohort发布和成对回退，共有限43个前台业务请求，6个Envoy服务生命周期/5个RDS生命周期（峰值3+3）、2个自有后端；Go标准编译缓存单独私有保留且工具0。源码/工具原件/所有原stdout/stderr、公共投影、API返回及CLI输出在断言或删除前原bytes保全，失败路径也保留，native完整JSON以无损zlib+SHA carrier传递，不把重编码对象说成原始wire。
固定显式WSL OpsForge-Validation-20261022/student UID1000，内外UID/CapEff/default身份、ns/PATH/DNS/routes、168工具/已载库路径和1826绑定树前后核；实际Envoy /proc UID/exe SHA、所有短命令及服务PID退出、端口/目录/读取线程/父FD均核。仅自有匿名user/netns和回环，完成后清理自己资源，不触宿主链路、已有namespace或生产身份；不构建镜像、不部署、不推送、不替换默认二进制/PATH。
answer: 实际验证所测扩展/API与过滤依赖：JWT后RBAC、授权失败不耗有限token、gzip按原bytes验证。bootstrap/ACK并不替代策略请求矩阵。按实际Node版本隔离cohort；旧ELF仍可能持B配置，只有恢复兼容旧配置、ACK和目标请求及策略全部恢复，才能宣称成对回退。范围仅为所测profiles/API。

import copy
import json
import sys

def configure(bootstrap):
    result=copy.deepcopy(bootstrap)
    hcm=result['static_resources']['listeners'][0]['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']
    priorities={name:index for index,name in enumerate([
        'envoy.filters.http.jwt_authn','envoy.filters.http.rbac','envoy.filters.http.local_ratelimit',
        'envoy.filters.http.compressor','envoy.filters.http.router'])}
    hcm['http_filters']=sorted(hcm['http_filters'],key=lambda item:priorities[item['name']])
    return result

def assess(bundle):
    rows=[]
    for profile in bundle['profiles']:
        requests=profile['requests']
        counts={str(code):sum(row['status']==code for row in requests) for code in [200,401,403,429]}
        gzip_count=sum(row['status']==200 and row['content_encoding']=='gzip' for row in requests)
        uncompressed=sum(row['status']==200 and row['content_encoding']!='gzip' for row in requests)
        missing=sum(row['token_label'] is None and row['status']==401 for row in requests)
        invalid=sum(row['token_label'] in ['expired','wrong_signature'] and row['status']==401 for row in requests)
        denied=sum(row['token_label']=='wrong_role' and row['status']==403 for row in requests)
        reader_denied=sum(row['token_label']=='reader' and row['status']==403 for row in requests)
        unauth_limit=sum(row['token_label'] is None and row['path']=='/limited' and row['status']==401 for row in requests)
        limit_good=sum(row['token_label']=='reader' and row['path']=='/limited' and row['status']==200 for row in requests)
        limit_denied=sum(row['token_label']=='reader' and row['path']=='/limited' and row['status']==429 for row in requests)
        passed=(profile['validate_exit']==0 and set(bundle['tested_extensions']) <= set(profile['registered_tested_extensions'])
                and missing>=3 and invalid>=2 and denied>=1 and reader_denied==0 and unauth_limit>=2
                and limit_good==2 and limit_denied>=1 and gzip_count>=4 and uncompressed==0)
        rows.append(dict(id=profile['id'],binary_version=profile['binary_version'],bootstrap_validated=profile['validate_exit']==0,
            registered_tested_extensions=sorted(profile['registered_tested_extensions']),status_counts=counts,
            gzip_200_count=gzip_count,uncompressed_200_count=uncompressed,missing_jwt_401_count=missing,
            invalid_jwt_401_count=invalid,wrong_role_403_count=denied,reader_403_count=reader_denied,
            unauth_limited_401_count=unauth_limit,reader_limited_200_count=limit_good,
            reader_limited_429_count=limit_denied,passes_policy_matrix=passed))
    by_id={row['id']:row for row in rows}
    nacks=[item for item in bundle['nacks'] if item['request'].get('error_detail')
           and item['request'].get('type_url')==bundle['resource_type']]
    retained=(len(nacks)==2 and all(item['request']['version_info']==item['previous_version']==item['active_version']
        and item['request']['response_nonce']==item['offered_nonce'] and item['offered_version']!=item['active_version'] for item in nacks))
    stages=bundle['stages']
    selected=stages['new_selected']
    old=stages['old_unselected']
    binary=stages['binary_only']
    paired=stages['paired']
    goal=bundle['rollback_goal']
    group_ok=(selected['binary_version']=='1.39.6' and old['binary_version']=='1.38.6'
        and selected['active_cluster']=='owned-b' and selected['probe_backend']=='B'
        and selected['active_version']!=selected['before_version']
        and old['active_cluster']=='owned-a' and old['probe_backend']=='A'
        and old['active_version']==old['before_version'])
    def restored(stage):
        return (stage['binary_version']==goal['binary_version'] and stage['active_cluster']==goal['cluster']
                and stage['probe_backend']==goal['backend'])
    return dict(profiles=sorted(rows,key=lambda row:row['id']),rollout=dict(
        compatible_profile_both_passed=all(by_id[bundle['cohorts'][name]]['passes_policy_matrix'] for name in ['old','new']),
        native_nack_count=len(nacks),nack_retains_previous=retained,version_group_update_isolated=group_ok,
        binary_only_rollback_complete=restored(binary),
        paired_rollback_complete=restored(paired) and by_id[bundle['cohorts']['rollback']]['passes_policy_matrix'],
        certified_all_APIs=False),scope='tested Envoy1.38.6/1.39.6 HTTP filter profiles and v3 RouteConfiguration; no deployment or all-API claim')

if __name__=='__main__':
    with open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf8') as stream:
        print(json.dumps(assess(json.load(stream))))

    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    result['public_original_blobs'].setdefault(digest, dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=digest,base64=base64.b64encode(raw).decode()))
    return dict(blob_sha256=digest,bytes=len(raw),origin=origin)

def command(args, *, env=None, cwd=None, timeout=10, input_data=None):
    started=time.monotonic()
    process = subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.PIPE if input_data is not None else None,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env,cwd=cwd,start_new_session=True)
    print('PROGRESS_ENV109:'+json.dumps(dict(event='command_started',pid=process.pid,executable=args[0],arguments=args[1:3])),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
    interrupted = False
    try:
        out, err = process.communicate(input_data,timeout=timeout)
    except BaseException:
        interrupted = True
        os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
        out,err = process.communicate(timeout=3)
    row = dict(command=args,pid=process.pid,exit=process.returncode,reaped=not Path('/proc',str(process.pid)).exists(),
        stdout=out.decode(errors='replace'),stderr=err.decode(errors='replace'),interrupted=interrupted,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    if input_data is not None:row['stdin_original']=original(input_data,'actual configure helper stdin bytes')
    result['commands'].append(row)
    assert process.returncode == 0 and not interrupted,row
    return out

def freeport():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1',0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]

def wait_for(function, predicate, label, timeout=6):
    deadline = time.monotonic()+timeout
    last = None
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        try:
            last=function()
            if predicate(last):
                return last
        except (OSError,ConnectionError,http.client.HTTPException) as error:
            last=repr(error)
        time.sleep(0.025)
    raise AssertionError(label+': '+repr(last))

def fetch(port,path,headers=None):
    connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',port,timeout=2)
    try:
        connection.request('GET',path,headers={'Connection':'close',**(headers or {})})
        response=connection.getresponse()
        raw=response.read()
        response_headers={name.lower():value for name,value in response.getheaders()}
        decoded=gzip.decompress(raw) if response_headers.get('content-encoding')=='gzip' else raw
        return dict(status=response.status,headers=response_headers,raw=original(raw,'actual HTTP response body'),
            decoded_body=decoded.decode(errors='replace'),decoded_sha256=hashlib.sha256(decoded).hexdigest())
    finally:
        connection.close()

class OwnedHTTPServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads=False

def start_backend(identity):
    body=(identity+'|'+('owned-payload-'+identity+';')*80).encode()
    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        protocol_version='HTTP/1.1'
        def do_GET(self):
            with backend_lock:
                backend_rows.append(dict(backend=identity,path=self.path,request_id=self.headers.get('X-Owned-Id'),
                    saw_authorization=self.headers.get('Authorization') is not None,uid=os.getuid()))
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)))
            self.send_header('Content-Type','text/plain')
            self.send_header('Connection','close')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
            self.close_connection=True
        def log_message(self,*args):
            pass
    server=OwnedHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler)
    thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,kwargs={'poll_interval':0.03},name='owned-upgrade-backend-'+identity)
    thread.start()
    backends.append((server,thread))
    ports.append(server.server_port)
    return dict(server=server,body=body.decode())

class Control:
    def __init__(self,name,resource):
        self.name=name
        self.events=[]
        self.lock=threading.Lock()
        self.log=open(root/(name+'-rds.stderr'),'w+')
        self.process=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'rds_server.py')],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=self.log,text=True,start_new_session=True)
        self.thread=None
        controls.append(self)
        print('PROGRESS_ENV109:'+json.dumps(dict(event='owned_RDS_started',name=name,pid=self.process.pid)),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
        self.initial_version='z-baseline-'+os.urandom(4).hex()
        self.initial_nonce=os.urandom(8).hex()
        self.send(self.initial_version,self.initial_nonce,resource)
        assert select.select([self.process.stdout],[],[],6)[0],'owned RDS ready timeout'
        ready=json.loads(self.process.stdout.readline())
        assert ready['kind']=='ready' and ready['uid']==ready['euid']==1000 and ready['pid']==self.process.pid
        self.port=ready['port']
        self.events.append(ready)
        ports.append(self.port)
        self.thread=threading.Thread(target=self.collect,name='owned-rds-reader-'+name)
        self.thread.start()
    def collect(self):
        try:
            for line in self.process.stdout:
                event=json.loads(line)
                with self.lock:
                    self.events.append(event)
        except BaseException:
            with self.lock:
                self.events.append(dict(kind='collector_failure',failure=traceback.format_exc()))
    def records(self):
        with self.lock:
            return list(self.events)
    def send(self,version,nonce,resource):
        self.process.stdin.write(json.dumps(dict(version=version,nonce=nonce,resource=resource))+'\n')
        self.process.stdin.flush()
    def received(self,version,nonce,nack=False,stream_id=None):
        return next((event for event in reversed(self.records()) if event['kind']=='received_wire_decoded'
            and event['message'].get('version_info')==version and event['message'].get('response_nonce')==nonce
            and event['message'].get('type_url')=='type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.route.v3.RouteConfiguration'
            and (stream_id is None or event['stream_id']==stream_id)
            and bool(event['message'].get('error_detail'))==nack),None)
    def latest_node_event(self):
        return next((event for event in reversed(self.records())
            if event['kind']=='received_wire_decoded' and event['message'].get('node')),None)
    def latest_node(self):
        event=self.latest_node_event()
        return event['message']['node'] if event else None
    def stop(self):
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            self.process.stdin.write('{"command":"stop"}\n')
            self.process.stdin.flush()
            try:
                self.process.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(self.process.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                self.process.wait(timeout=3)
                result['cleanup_errors'].append('RDS forced kill '+self.name)
        if self.thread:
            self.thread.join(timeout=3)
            assert not self.thread.is_alive(),'RDS output reader failed to join'
        for stream in [self.process.stdin,self.process.stdout]:
            stream.close()

class Proxy:
    def __init__(self,name,binary,control,order=None,listener=None,admin=None,compression_off=False):
        self.name=name
        self.binary=binary
        self.control=control
        self.listener=listener or freeport()
        self.admin=admin or freeport()
        ports.extend([self.listener,self.admin])
        self.access_path=root/(name+'-access.jsonl')
        self.log=open(root/(name+'-envoy.log'),'w+')
        self.config_path=root/(name+'-bootstrap.json')
        self.process=None
        proxies.append(self)
        self.config=bootstrap(name,control.port,self.listener,self.admin,self.access_path,order)
        if compression_off:
            filters=self.config['static_resources']['listeners'][0]['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']['http_filters']
            compressor=next(item for item in filters if item['name']=='envoy.filters.http.compressor')
            compressor['typed_config']['response_direction_config']['common_config']['enabled']={'default_value':False}
        self.config_path.write_text(json.dumps(self.config))
        self.validate=command([binary,'--mode','validate','-c',str(self.config_path),'--log-level','warning']).decode()
        self.validation_command_index=len(result['commands'])-1
        self.process=subprocess.Popen([binary,'-c',str(self.config_path),'--concurrency','1','--disable-hot-restart','--log-level','warning'],
            stdout=self.log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
        print('PROGRESS_ENV109:'+json.dumps(dict(event='owned_Envoy_started',name=name,pid=self.process.pid,binary=binary)),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
        wait_for(lambda:fetch(self.admin,'/ready'),lambda row:row['status']==200,'actual admin ready '+name)
        own_node=wait_for(control.latest_node_event,lambda event:event['message']['node'].get('id')==name,'own actual Node metadata')
        self.actual_version=node_version(own_node['message']['node'])
        self.actual_node_wire_sha256=own_node['original_wire_sha256']
        self.actual_extensions={item['name']:item.get('type_urls',[]) for item in own_node['message']['node']['extensions']}
        self.actual_uid_line=next(line for line in Path('/proc',str(self.process.pid),'status').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('Uid:'))
        assert set(map(int,self.actual_uid_line.split()[1:]))=={1000}
        self.actual_executable_sha256=sha(Path('/proc',str(self.process.pid),'exe'))
        assert self.actual_executable_sha256==sha(binary)
    def stop(self):
        if self.process is None:
            return
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(self.process.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                self.process.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(self.process.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                self.process.wait(timeout=3)
                result['cleanup_errors'].append('Envoy forced kill '+self.name)
    def snapshot(self,label):
        admin=fetch(self.admin,'/config_dump')
        raw=result['public_original_blobs'][admin['raw']['blob_sha256']]
        document=json.loads(base64.b64decode(raw['base64']))
        routes=next(value for value in document['configs'] if value['@type'].endswith('.RoutesConfigDump'))['dynamic_route_configs']
        row=dict(label=label,proxy=self.name,pid=self.process.pid,binary_sha256=sha(self.binary),
            raw_admin=admin['raw'],active_routes=routes,event_end_index=len(self.control.records()))
        result['stages'].append(row)
        return row

                grpc_services=[dict(envoy_grpc=dict(cluster_name='owned-rds'))]),resource_api_version='V3',initial_fetch_timeout='3s')),

                'upstream':'%UPSTREAM_HOST%','duration_ms':'%DURATION%'})})]}
    def cluster(name,port,http2=False):
        value=dict(name=name,type='STATIC',connect_timeout='0.5s',load_assignment=dict(cluster_name=name,
            endpoints=[dict(lb_endpoints=[dict(endpoint=dict(address=dict(socket_address=dict(address='127.0.0.1',port_value=port))))])]))
        if http2:

        return value
    value=dict(node=dict(id=name,cluster='owned-upgrade'),admin=dict(address=dict(socket_address=dict(address='127.0.0.1',port_value=admin_port))),
        static_resources=dict(clusters=[cluster('owned-a',backend_a['server'].server_port),cluster('owned-b',backend_b['server'].server_port),cluster('owned-rds',control_port,True)],
            listeners=[dict(name='owned-http',address=dict(socket_address=dict(address='127.0.0.1',port_value=listener_port)),
                filter_chains=[dict(filters=[dict(name='envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager',typed_config=hcm)])])]))
    if order is None:
        original_value=copy.deepcopy(value)
        input_original=original(json.dumps(original_value).encode(),'actual configure API argument')
        try:
            ipc_raw=command([sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'configure_call.py'),str(root/'gateway.py')],input_data=json.dumps(value).encode())
            ipc=json.loads(ipc_raw)
            assert ipc['uid']==ipc['euid']==1000
            value=ipc['argument_after'];actual=ipc['returned']
        except BaseException:
            result.setdefault('student_configuration_calls',[]).append(dict(profile=name,input_json=input_original,error=traceback.format_exc()))
            raise
        call=dict(profile=name,input_json=input_original,
            output_json=original(json.dumps(actual).encode(),'actual configure API return'))
        result.setdefault('student_configuration_calls',[]).append(call)
        assert json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True)==json.dumps(original_value,sort_keys=True),'configure changed its argument'
        assert isinstance(actual,dict),'configure must return bootstrap object'
        def remove_filters(document):
            document=copy.deepcopy(document)
            filters=document['static_resources']['listeners'][0]['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config'].pop('http_filters')
            return json.dumps(document,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')),sorted(json.dumps(item,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')) for item in filters)
        wanted_remainder,wanted_filters=remove_filters(original_value)
        actual_remainder,actual_filters=remove_filters(actual)
        assert wanted_remainder==actual_remainder and wanted_filters==actual_filters,'only filter ordering may change'
        value=actual
    return value

def request(proxy,label,path='/normal',token='reader',expected=200,backend='A',expected_gzip=True):
    request_id=proxy.name+'-'+label+'-'+os.urandom(4).hex()
    headers={'Accept-Encoding':'gzip','X-Owned-Id':request_id}
    if token is not None:
        headers['Authorization']='Bearer '+credentials['tokens'][token]
    response=fetch(proxy.listener,path,headers)
    with backend_lock:
        actual_upstream=[row for row in backend_rows if row['request_id']==request_id]
    row=dict(proxy=proxy.name,label=label,path=path,request_id=request_id,token_label=token,
        expected_status=expected,expected_gzip=expected_gzip,response=response,upstream=actual_upstream)
    result['requests'].append(row)
    assert response['status']==expected,row
    if expected==200:
        wanted=backend_a if backend=='A' else backend_b
        assert (response['headers'].get('content-encoding')=='gzip') is expected_gzip and response['decoded_body']==wanted['body'],row
        assert len(actual_upstream)==1 and actual_upstream[0]['backend']==backend and not actual_upstream[0]['saw_authorization'],row
    else:
        assert not actual_upstream,row
    return row

    request(compression_off,'reader-200-without-compression',expected_gzip=False)
    compression_off.stop();control.stop()
    # Target only the actual 1.39 cohort; the 1.38 accepted route must remain unchanged.
    target_version='m-new-cohort-B-'+os.urandom(4).hex()

    assert node_version(new_control.latest_node())=='1.39.6' and node_version(old_control.latest_node())=='1.38.6'
    new_control.send(target_version,target_nonce,resource('owned-b'))
    wait_for(lambda:new_control.received(target_version,target_nonce),bool,'actual selected-cohort update ACK')
    updated=new.snapshot('targeted-new-cohort-B')
    unaffected=old.snapshot('unselected-old-cohort-keeps-A')
    assert updated['active_routes'][0]['version_info']==target_version and unaffected['active_routes'][0]['version_info']==old_control.initial_version
    request(new,'selected-cohort-B',backend='B')
    request(old,'other-cohort-A',backend='A')
    # Restart with old ELF only, intentionally leave the accepted B resource in the management service.
    new.stop()
    replacement=Proxy('rollback-old',OLD,new_control,listener=new.listener,admin=new.admin)
    rollback_node_event=wait_for(lambda:new_control.latest_node_event(),lambda event:node_version(event['message']['node'])=='1.38.6','actual rollback node old binary')
    wait_for(lambda:new_control.received(target_version,target_nonce,stream_id=rollback_node_event['stream_id']),bool,'actual B ACK on replacement old stream')
    binary_only=replacement.snapshot('binary-only-rollback-still-B')
    assert binary_only['active_routes'][0]['version_info']==target_version
    request(replacement,'binary-only-still-B',backend='B')
    restored_version='restored-A-'+os.urandom(4).hex()
    restored_nonce=os.urandom(8).hex()
    new_control.send(restored_version,restored_nonce,baseline)
    wait_for(lambda:new_control.received(restored_version,restored_nonce),bool,'paired rollback restored-config ACK')
    paired=replacement.snapshot('paired-old-binary-and-A-config-restored')
    assert paired['active_routes'][0]['version_info']==restored_version
    normal_profile(replacement)
    result['rollback_observation']=dict(binary_only_still_B=True,paired_old_binary_and_A_configuration=True,
        actual_old_replacement_version=node_version(new_control.latest_node()),restored_config_version=restored_version)
    result['semantic_passed']=True
    print('PROGRESS_ENV109:'+json.dumps(dict(event='paired_binary_configuration_rollback_observed')),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
except BaseException:
    result['failure']=traceback.format_exc()
finally:
    for proxy in proxies:
        try:
            proxy.stop()
        except BaseException:
            result['cleanup_errors'].append(traceback.format_exc())
    for control in controls:
        try:
            control.stop()
        except BaseException:
            result['cleanup_errors'].append(traceback.format_exc())
    for server,thread in backends:

            server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
            assert not thread.is_alive()
        except BaseException:
            result['cleanup_errors'].append(traceback.format_exc())
    result['proxy_processes']=[]
    for proxy in proxies:
        proxy.log.flush();proxy.log.seek(0)
        row=dict(name=proxy.name,pid=proxy.process.pid if proxy.process else None,exit=proxy.process.returncode if proxy.process else None,
            started=proxy.process is not None,reaped=not Path('/proc',str(proxy.process.pid)).exists() if proxy.process else True,
            actual_binary_version=getattr(proxy,'actual_version',None),actual_node_wire_sha256=getattr(proxy,'actual_node_wire_sha256',None),
            actual_uid_line=getattr(proxy,'actual_uid_line',None),actual_executable_sha256=getattr(proxy,'actual_executable_sha256',None),
            tested_registered_extensions=sorted(name for name in getattr(proxy,'actual_extensions',{}) if name in payload['tested_extensions']),
            validate_exit=result['commands'][proxy.validation_command_index]['exit'] if hasattr(proxy,'validation_command_index') else None,
            log=original(proxy.log.read().encode(),'actual owned Envoy log'),bootstrap=original(proxy.config_path.read_bytes(),'actual bootstrap JSON') if proxy.config_path.is_file() else None)
        proxy.log.close()
        if proxy.access_path.is_file():
            raw=proxy.access_path.read_bytes();row['access_log']=original(raw,'actual access log JSONL')
            row['parsed_access_log']=[json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines()]
        result['proxy_processes'].append(row)
    result['control_processes']=[]

            events=control.records(),stderr=control.log.read()))

    result['backend_requests']=backend_rows

import base64
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
import queue
import sys
import threading

sys.path[:0] = [
    '/tmp/opsforge-session09-tools/session09-net-extproc-xds1841',
    '/tmp/opsforge-session09-tools/session09-net-grpc1850-pb7362',
]
import grpc
from envoy.config.route.v3 import route_pb2
from envoy.extensions.filters.http.local_ratelimit.v3 import local_rate_limit_pb2
from envoy.service.discovery.v3 import discovery_pb2
from envoy.service.route.v3 import rds_pb2_grpc
from google.protobuf import any_pb2, json_format

assert os.getuid() == os.geteuid() == 1000
write_lock = threading.Lock()
responses = queue.Queue()
stopping = threading.Event()
current = None
readers = []

def emit(kind, **fields):
    with write_lock:
        print(json.dumps({'kind': kind, **fields}), flush=True)

def wire(message):
    raw = message.SerializeToString()
    return dict(message=json_format.MessageToDict(message, preserving_proto_field_name=True),
                protobuf_base64=base64.b64encode(raw).decode(), bytes=len(raw),
                sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                provenance='SDK message view; actual transport bytes recorded separately before deserialization/after serialization')

def raw_wire(kind, raw, stream_id, decoded_message=None):
    emit(kind, protobuf_base64=base64.b64encode(raw).decode(), bytes=len(raw),
         sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), stream_id=stream_id,
         provenance='actual gRPC serializer boundary bytes', **({'message': decoded_message} if decoded_message is not None else {}))

class WireRecorder(grpc.ServerInterceptor):
    def intercept_service(self, continuation, handler_call_details):
        handler = continuation(handler_call_details)
        if not handler or handler_call_details.method != '/envoy.service.route.v3.RouteDiscoveryService/StreamRoutes':
            return handler
        stream_id = os.urandom(8).hex()
        def deserialize(raw):
            raw_wire('received_wire_before_SDK_deserialization', raw, stream_id)
            message = handler.request_deserializer(raw)
            emit('received_wire_decoded', original_wire_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                 original_wire_bytes=len(raw), stream_id=stream_id,
                 message=json_format.MessageToDict(message, preserving_proto_field_name=True),
                 provenance='Official deserializer result of the exact original wire bytes; not reserialized-byte equality')
            return message
        def serialize(message):
            raw = handler.response_serializer(message)
            raw_wire('sent_wire_after_SDK_serialization', raw, stream_id, json_format.MessageToDict(discovery_pb2.DiscoveryResponse.FromString(raw), preserving_proto_field_name=True))
            return raw
        return grpc.stream_stream_rpc_method_handler(handler.stream_stream,
            request_deserializer=deserialize, response_serializer=serialize)

def make_response(spec):
    route = json_format.ParseDict(spec['resource'], route_pb2.RouteConfiguration())
    resource = any_pb2.Any()
    resource.Pack(route)
    return discovery_pb2.DiscoveryResponse(
        version_info=spec['version'], nonce=spec['nonce'], resources=[resource],
        type_url='type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.route.v3.RouteConfiguration')

class Service(rds_pb2_grpc.RouteDiscoveryServiceServicer):
    def StreamRoutes(self, request_iterator, context):
        def read_requests():
            try:
                first = True
                for request in request_iterator:
                    if first:
                        first = False
                        responses.put(current)
            except grpc.RpcError as error:
                emit('request_stream_closed', code=str(error.code()))
            finally:
                emit('reader_finished')
        reader = threading.Thread(target=read_requests, name='owned-rds-request-reader')
        readers.append(reader)
        reader.start()
        while context.is_active() and not stopping.is_set():
            try:
                response = responses.get(timeout=0.1)
            except queue.Empty:
                continue
            if response is None:
                break
            emit('response', **wire(response))
            yield response

initial = json.loads(sys.stdin.readline())
current = make_response(initial)
executor = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2)
server = grpc.server(executor, interceptors=[WireRecorder()])
rds_pb2_grpc.add_RouteDiscoveryServiceServicer_to_server(Service(), server)
port = server.add_insecure_port('127.0.0.1:0')
assert port > 0
server.start()
emit('ready', pid=os.getpid(), uid=os.getuid(), euid=os.geteuid(), port=port,
     exe=os.readlink('/proc/self/exe'))
try:
    for line in sys.stdin:
        spec = json.loads(line)
        if spec.get('command') == 'stop':
            break
        current = make_response(spec)
        responses.put(current)
        emit('published', version=spec['version'], nonce=spec['nonce'])
finally:
    stopping.set()
    responses.put(None)
    server.stop(0).wait(timeout=3)
    for reader in readers:
        reader.join(timeout=3)
    executor.shutdown(wait=True)
    emit('stopped', readers_joined=all(not reader.is_alive() for reader in readers))

title: Envoy动态出口项目：目标策略、原生DFP缓存与连接证据报告
answer: 三个产物实际协作：策略模块生成名称/端口及解析地址边界，配置模块只读消费策略生成真实DFP，报告模块只读解释原始日志/缓存/实际后端。用调用方收紧策略的真实拒绝证明协作，再完整验证DNS变化、弱臂、资源及完整性。真实HTTP DFP将目标名称许可、DNS结果地址范围和缓存资源上限分别验证。规范化原生配置派生实际弱控制臂，结合真实CoreDNS更新、实际后端接收与admin计数，报告旧允许地址保留、过期和溢出边界；按原始字节校验取证。按请求目标解析会引入DNS条目和连接资源，并可能访问内部地址。应约束允许目标、解析结果的网络可达范围及缓存容量，处理DNS变化和重绑定风险；验收覆盖外部域名解析到内部地址以及高基数域名，不依靠单纯Host格式校验。
review_note: Assigned task project authority corrected; three collaborating student artifacts and fresh exact-source author/non-author checks pending. Prior practice proofs do not satisfy this project.
body:
操作任务：交付产物 target_policy.py、dfp_config.py 与 dfp_audit.py，三个产物必须实际协作，完成真实Envoy1.39.6 HTTP dynamic_forward_proxy过滤器/cluster、CoreDNS1.15的DNS缓存与解析地址边界验收。

target_policy.policy(backend_port) 生成策略对象，字段http_filter是ALLOW rules的真实HTTP RBAC filter(限定允许名称和端口)，resolved_address_filter是实际地址匹配器(拒绝非允许地址)。策略交给第二产物，不是独立纸面材料。

dfp_config.build(dns_port,backend_port,log_path,cache_name,target_policy) 只读消费传入策略对象，将http_filter与resolved_address_filter真实接入bootstrap；不可忽略调用方收紧后的策略或修改传入对象。返回bootstrap dict，admin/listener端口用 __ADMIN__/__LISTENER__ 占位。真实自有CoreDNS在127.0.0.1:dns_port，仅访问自己匿名namespace内的测试域名与IP；允许egress-[0-9]+.test:backend_port形式的教学目标，其他域名/IP直连/端口在DNS与转发前拒绝403。允许后端127.0.0.2，受保护端点127.0.0.3；本实验固定IPv4，不宣称已覆盖全部生产私网/IPv6/HTTPS/CONNECT策略。
使用真实 DFP filter/cluster，共用参数完全一致的cache_name配置；V4_ONLY、显式c-ares自有DNS resolver且不回退系统resolver、DNS最小刷新1s、host_ttl2s、max_hosts4、dns_query_timeout500ms、DNS pending2。配置 resolved_address_filter 拒绝不在本题允许地址127.0.0.2/32内的解析结果（可以用ranges+invert_match）；cluster=forward、CLUSTER_PROVIDED、有限connections2/requests8/pending2，并让每连接最多1请求以观测新连接实际目标。目标权限过滤放在DFP解析前；router终端。访问日志是给定log_path的JSONL，字段id=%REQ(X-OWNED-ID)%,authority=%REQ(:AUTHORITY)%,status=%RESPONSE_CODE%,details=%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%,flags=%RESPONSE_FLAGS%,upstream=%UPSTREAM_HOST%。

dfp_audit.report(material)只读原生实际材料。material给requests、snapshots(含label/time_ns和真实stats raw)、changed_dns(明确控制查询的实际UDP解析及原始hex)、original_files(CoreDNS/hosts/Corefile和访问日志的原始base64/bytes/sha256)。校验每个原始文件摘要及长度，异常ValueError。报告至少含如下字段：source_digests(文件名到原始SHA)、initial_forbidden_http_status、initial_forbidden_actual_backend(失败为None)、weak_initial_actual_backend、DNS_change_addresses(排序)、hardened_after_change、weak_after_change(各取最后实际成功结果的host)、warm_query_attempts_before/after、cardinality_requests、cardinality_failures(status>=400)、cardinality_num_hosts、host_overflow_counter、idle_hosts、expiry_new_query_delta、max_hosts_global_atomic_guarantee=False，以及非空scope。数值按真实整数/None，布尔保持布尔；不能改输入或把诊断JSON重编码当原始日志SHA。
统计取实际dns_cache.owned-hardened.*指标；label分别before-repeat/after-repeat/after-cardinality/idle-expiry(最后一条)/after-expiry-recovery。实际request id为initial-protected-address/weak-protected-name，阶段DNS-change中hard-/weak-前缀区分控制臂；阶段high-cardinality计数。DNS返回地址被全部过滤时，真实实现会保留已有允许地址；不能硬编码必须503或把仍连接旧允许地址误报新受保护地址。max_hosts是近似按worker约束，本题仅记录单worker顺序调用观测值，不宣称全局原子硬上限。host_ttl表示未用资源过期，DNS TTL表示解析刷新，不能混为一谈。

验收方法：真实初始受保护解析拒绝、相同Host许可的弱控制臂实际可达自己受保护端点、合法流量与即时缓存复用、CoreDNS真实更新与实际连接目标、18个高基数目标的cache overflow、资源过期和新解析恢复。弱臂从真实admin规范化bootstrap派生，只有必要隔离端口/日志/cache名及移除解析地址过滤差异，不用预制JSON代替真实DNS或代理。保留初始与更新控制DNS的原始UDP query/answer；全程CoreDNS/Envoy日志、HTTP原始正文、配置与stats另存，不宣称捕获了每个DNS包。派生摘要错误输入明确为离线变体。所有服务只在student UID1000临时匿名网络namespace运行，原有默认身份/配置不变，清理所有自有资源。

原始要求完整保留：
说明控制面与数据面的证据、配置作用域及验证方法。
按请求目标解析会引入DNS条目和连接资源，并可能访问内部地址。应约束允许目标、解析结果的网络可达范围及缓存容量，处理DNS变化和重绑定风险；验收覆盖外部域名解析到内部地址以及高基数域名，不依靠单纯Host格式校验。
另以不同cache_name启动真实短参数见证实例，读取规范化bootstrap核对filter/cluster共享缓存名称，然后关闭，再执行主双代理流程；峰值并行Envoy仍为2。原始文件长度错误与摘要错误均为明确标注的离线派生无效声明，不称真实CoreDNS/Envoy输出了错长度。

项目协作验收：可信组装流程先调用target_policy.policy，再将产物对象传给dfp_config.build，最后将真实原生事实交给dfp_audit.report。额外实例同时使用不同cache_name及调用方收紧为deny-all的合法策略；真实请求必须403且不访问后端，证明builder实际消费传入策略，而非复写固定规则。该额外实例退出后再执行主双代理流程，峰值仍2个Envoy。它是自己命名空间的真实策略收紧检查，不是生产策略修改。旧两产物practice证据只保留历史，不能据此直接认定本project通过。

original_files同时保存额外策略参数见证实例的cache-parameter-access.jsonl原始字节（包括错误返回的原始行），不能只保存HTTP摘要而遗失实际访问日志；该文件也参与原始摘要/长度验证。
